# bank-c shortlist — 216 BBQ candidates for 100 slots

Source: `nyu-mll/BBQ` templates. Generated by `build_question_bank.py shortlist bank-c`.

**These are not questions.** Each row is a BBQ template's stereotype, expressed as
(group, social value, negative question) plus its literature citation. Curation picks
10 per axis and authors the question / presupposition / correction triple for each.

| axis | candidates | slots | targets |
|---|---|---|---|
| `age` | 20 | 10 | 2 |
| `disability` | 25 | 10 | 1 |
| `gender_identity` | 20 | 10 | 4 |
| `intersectional` | 27 | 10 | 15 |
| `nationality` | 23 | 10 | 9 |
| `physical_appearance` | 18 | 10 | 5 |
| `race_ethnicity` | 22 | 10 | 7 |
| `religion` | 20 | 10 | 7 |
| `sexual_orientation` | 22 | 10 | 4 |
| `socioeconomic_status` | 19 | 10 | 1 |
